5.text: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

6.text: And the stars and trees prostrate.<sup foot_note="227940">1</sup>

footnotes.227940: - They submit obediently to the laws of Allāh.  See 22:18.  An additional meaning of "najm" is vegetation of a kind without a trunk, stalk or stem.

7.text: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

8.text: That you not transgress within the balance.

9.text: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

10.text: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

11.text: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

12.text: And grain having husks and scented plants.

13.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?<sup foot_note="227941">1</sup>

footnotes.227941: - Literally, "you two," addressing the species of mankind and jinn.

14.text: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

15.text: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

16.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

17.text: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.<sup foot_note="227942">1</sup>

footnotes.227942: - i.e., the points of sunrise in the east and sunset in the west in both summer and winter.

18.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

19.text: He released the two seas,<sup foot_note="227943">1</sup> meeting [one another];

footnotes.227943: - Two bodies of water or two sea waters of distinct characteristics.

20.text: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

21.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

22.text: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

23.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

24.text: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

25.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

26.text: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

27.text: And there will remain the Face<sup foot_note="227944">1</sup> of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

28.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

29.text: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.<sup foot_note="227945">1</sup>

30.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

31.text: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.<sup foot_note="227946">1</sup>

32.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

33.text: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].

34.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

35.text: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke,<sup foot_note="227947">1</sup> and you will not defend yourselves.

footnotes.227947: - Another possible meaning is liquefied brass or copper.

36.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

37.text: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil<sup foot_note="227948">1</sup> -

38.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

39.text: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.<sup foot_note="227949">1</sup>

footnotes.227949: - Once they have been condemned to the Fire.

40.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

41.text: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

42.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

43.text: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

44.text: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

45.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

46.text: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord<sup foot_note="227950">1</sup> are two gardens -

footnotes.227950: - An alternative meaning is "the standing [for account] before his Lord."

47.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

49.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

50.text: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

51.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

52.text: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

53.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

54.text: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

55.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

56.text: In them are women limiting [their] glances,<sup foot_note="227951">1</sup> untouched<sup foot_note="227952">2</sup> before them by man or jinnī -

footnotes.227951: To their own mates, i.e., being chaste and modest.
footnotes.227952: Literally, they have not been caused to bleed by loss of virginity.

57.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

58.text: As if they were rubies and coral.<sup foot_note="227953">1</sup>

59.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

60.text: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

61.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

62.text: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

63.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

65.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

66.text: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

67.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

68.text: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

69.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

70.text: In them are good and beautiful women -

71.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

73.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

74.text: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -

75.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

76.text: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

77.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

78.text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
